items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: The guy that did the complaining about being too loud was Seymour Weiss, the owner of the hotel.

ctx.x: I think it was -- let's see.
The guy that did the complaining about being too loud was Seymour Weiss, the owner of the hotel.

I see. And how about -- I'm looking for which book I found it in. I think it was George Simon's book. Said the reason you left there was that they wanted you to play softer and you wouldn't, and so they set up some guys in the red light district, some guys in your band, and busted them, and then the band had to leave town. Is that right?
